description: Independent persistence settings for browser E2E against the tracked baseline. Paths resolve relative to this file. Shared-root writes require the E2E snapshot and restoration lifecycle.

settings.root: Tracked baseline used by serial browser E2E. Restore designated E2E post data from Git and protected data from its snapshot.
settings.contentMaxCodePoints: Maximum content length compatible with the existing baseline chunks.
settings.titleMaxCodePoints: Maximum title length compatible with the existing baseline metadata.
settings.summaryMaxCodePoints: Maximum summary length compatible with the existing baseline metadata.
settings.supportedMediaTypes: Image formats enabled for browser E2E.
